comments.text: So glad I found this program today, on the 26th of August 2026... I am thoroughly enjoying the narration of this island's history... I live in Australia and as a Hungarian woman coming here in 1958 I was child of 12 years old, I thought it was the end of the world... Australia is a very large, gigantic island, for sure... I can..  imagine an island the size of SABA; it must be a smaller, much smaller island... How large is it, and are the residents multilingual? It is so fascinating learning about countries from regions of the world I have never heard of...Is Saba in a tropical region? Must be beautiful to live there for sure... Do the Saba islanders have their own Ethnic Music, if I am not silly to ask, please...I am just asking, being of Hungarian ethnicity, and besides this, I simply love learning about countries with their languages and traditional folk music...Anyway, I am happy I discovered your country on YouTube...Greetings from Australia, from an old 80-year-old Hungarian Lady in New South Wales,Australia...
